summary: Contractor SCA seat swap, trial consolidation, and SCIM provisioning
description:
Issue summary:
Security and Engineering Product (EdgeOps) request a consolidated procurement and seat reallocation for a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) vendor. We currently have multiple overlapping trials and a small paid plan for two different SCA vendors used by different teams; EdgeOps wants to standardize on one vendor for developer scanning and contractor access.

Impact:
- Fragmented tooling creating duplicate alerts and audit overhead for Security.
- Contractors and short-term vendors are on a paid seat pool that must be reclaimed and reallocated quickly for an upcoming on-prem migration (target date: 2026-03-01).
- Need SCIM/Okta provisioning and delegated admin for Security to manage contractor churn.

Request / Acceptance criteria:
1) Procure 50 developer seats for chosen SCA vendor (annual subscription, enterprise plan with SCIM & audit exports).
2) Reassign 15 contractor seats from current paid pool into the new tenant (seat-swap) with no double-billing.
3) Consolidate two active trials (VendorA trial: 18 seats; VendorB trial: 8 seats) into the new purchase and terminate unused trial instances.
4) Configure SCIM provisioning via Okta, delegated admin for Security, and a Splunk export/ webhook for vulnerability events.
5) Provide billing to cost center CC-ENG-OPS; one PO to finance; target invoice date before 2026-02-28.

Background / Notes:
- Current vendors in use: VendorA (trial, team: Platform Sec), VendorB (paid small team, team: Research), and a separate contractor seat pool managed manually in a Google Sheet.
- Security requires retention of audit logs for 90 days for SOC2 evidence and a single consolidated admin for audits.
- EdgeOps migration to on-prem requires contractor scans to run against local registries; vendor must support private registry scanning or provide a secure agent.

Budget: $18,000 USD (est. annual) charged to CC-ENG-OPS.

Dependencies:
- Finance: PO + vendor contract signature.
- Identity: Okta SCIM app configuration and test account.
- Legal: vendor DPA review (if not already completed).

Proposed vendor(s): GuardianSCA (primary candidate) or VendorA as fallback. GuardianSCA quoted enterprise plan supporting SCIM/agent and Splunk export.

Steps to complete / deliverables:
- Procurement creates PO and sends to vendor legal/finance.
- Security and IT configure SCIM/Okta; Security verifies delegated admin rights.
- Migrate / reassign contractor seats and terminate redundant trials.
- Validate Splunk ingestion and audit retention.
- Confirm invoice and tag to CC-ENG-OPS.
justification: Reduce tool sprawl, centralize alerts/audit logs for SOC2 readiness, and enable faster contractor onboarding during the on-prem migration.
acceptance_criteria: 1) PO issued and vendor confirmed; 2) Okta SCIM live and 15 contractor accounts migrated; 3) Splunk export validated and 90d audit retention confirmed; 4) Trials decommissioned and no duplicate billing observed.
tasks: Confirm final vendor pricing and contract terms with Legal/Finance
Raise PO and attach budget code CC-ENG-OPS
Set up GuardianSCA Okta SCIM app in staging and test provisioning
Migrate contractor accounts and verify access/alerts
Disable VendorA and VendorB trial instances once migration verified
Validate Splunk event ingestion and retention policy
